official: 特別区の消防団員等の公務災害補償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 消防団員などの公務災害補償の基準額を改定
summary: 特別区の消防団員などの公務災害補償には、補償基礎額が定められています。この議案では、その額を改定し、扶養親族に関する規定も変更します。2026年4月1日から施行し、傷病・障害・遺族補償年金には同年4月分から新しい規定を適用します。
changes: 補償基礎額を9,700円から10,000円、14,500円から15,000円などに引き上げる
扶養親族に関する額を100円から433円に改める
扶養親族1人につき383円とする規定を削る
who: 公務災害補償を受ける特別区の消防団員など
why: 損害補償の基準を定める政令の改正に伴い、補償基礎額の改定と規定の整理が必要なためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Revises standard amounts for line-of-duty injury compensation for fire brigade members and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Line-of-Duty Injuries to Fire Brigade Members, etc. of the Special Wards
en.summary: Compensation for line-of-duty injuries to fire brigade members and others in the special wards includes a basic compensation amount. This bill revises that amount and changes provisions relating to dependent family members. It takes effect on April 1, 2026. The new provisions apply to injury and sickness, disability, and survivors’ compensation pensions starting with the payments for April of the same year.
changes: Raises the basic compensation amount, including from ¥9,700 to ¥10,000 and from ¥14,500 to ¥15,000
Changes the amount relating to dependent family members from ¥100 to ¥433
Removes the provision setting the amount at ¥383 for each dependent family member
who: Fire brigade members and others in the special wards who receive line-of-duty injury compensation
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the revision of a Cabinet Order setting standards for compensation for damages makes it necessary to revise the basic compensation amount and reorganize the provisions.
